breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained a contradiction by specifying both 'time_integration: Explicit forward Euler' and 'method: Strang splitting'. The ground truth resolves this by removing the incorrect 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction, as the detailed Strang splitting steps are the intended method. The generated specification failed to fix this; instead, it merged the conflicting instructions into 'Implement the time integration using Strang splitting with explicit forward Euler', which is incorrect and does not resolve the ambiguity. It should have discarded the 'Explicit forward Euler' part.
